spans.s:
जट् जट् (probably a rt. derived fr. जट
below), cl. 1. P. जटति, &c., to clot, to form
into a concrete mass, to become twisted together or
entangled and matted as hair; [cf. झट्.]

जट जट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. जन् ?), wearing
twisted or entangled locks of hair; (आ), f. the hair
matted and twisted together as worn by the god
Śiva and by ascetics and persons in mourning; the
long tresses of hair twisted or braided together, and
coiled in a knot over the head so as to project like
a horn from the forehead, or at other times allowed
to fall carelessly over the back and shoulders; a
fibrous root, a root in general; N. of several plants,
= जटा-मांसी; Mucuna Pruritus, Flacourtia Cata-
phracta; Asparagus Racemosus; also = रुद्र-जटा
[cf. कृष्ण-जटा]; N. of a Pāṭha or arrangement
of the Vedic text so called from a peculiar repetition
[]
and inversion of the words, (it is a still more artificial
arrangement than the Krama-pāṭha, each pair of words
being repeated three times and one repetition being
in inverted order.)
—जटा-कर, अस्, आ, अम्, matting
the hair.
—जटा-चीर or जटाटीर, अस्, m. a N. of
Śiva.
—जटा-जूट, अस्, m. the long tresses of hair
twisted on the top of the head; a quantity of twisted
hair; Śiva's hair.
—जटा-ज्वाल, अस्, m. ‘having a
flame like a tuft,’ a lamp.
—जटा-टङ्क, अस्, m. an
epithet of Śiva; [cf. कटङ्कट.]
—जटा-धर, अस्,
आ, अम्, wearing twisted or matted hair; (अस्), m.
any mendicant or ascetic wearing the Jaṭā; an epithet
of Śiva; N. of one of the attendants of Skanda; N.
of a Buddha; N. of a lexicographer; (आस्), m. pl.,
N. of a people in the south of India.
—जटा-धारिन्,
ई, इणी, इ, wearing matted or braided hair.
—जटा-
पाठ, अस्, m. the Jaṭā reading or arrangement of
the Vedic text, see above.
—जटा-बन्ध, अस्, m.
the knot or coil of matted hair.
—जटा-मण्डल,
अम्, n. braided or twisted hair forming a coil on
the top of the head.
—जटा-मांसी, f. the plant
Nardostachys Jaṭāmāṃsi.
—जटा-मालिन्, ई, m., N. of
a form of Śiva, ‘garlanded with matted hair.’
—जटा-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, wearing the Jaṭā, wearing knotted or
clotted hair; (ती), f. = जटा-मांसी.
—जटा-वल्ली, f.,
N. of two plants, = रुद्र-जटा and गन्ध-मांसी.
—जटासुर (˚टा-अस्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Rakṣas
killed by Bhīma-sena; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people
living in the north-east of Madhya-deśa.
—जटे-
श्वर-तीर्थ (˚टा-ईश्˚), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.

जटायु, उस्, and जटायुस्, उस्, m., N. of a fabulous
bird, the king of the vultures (गृध्र-राज), son
of Aruṇa and Śyenī (or according to the Rāmāyaṇa,
son of Garuḍa), and younger brother of Sampāti.
(It is related in Chap. XX of the Araṇya-kāṇḍa of
the Rāmāyaṇa, that whilst Rāma was on his way to
Pañcavatī he met Jaṭāyus, who declared his intention
of aiding Rāma, out of regard for his father Daśa-
ratha. Accordingly when Rāvaṇa carried off Sītā,
the semi-divine bird attempted to rescue her, but
was defeated and mortally wounded by Rāvaṇa;
Chap. LVI); bdellium, see गुग्गुलु; N. of a
mountain.

जटाल, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing a coil of twisted or
clotted hair; (अस्), m. bdellium; a kind of Curcuma
(कर्चूर); the plant Bignonia Suaveolens; the Indian
fig-tree or वट; (आ), f. = जटा-मांसी.

जटालक, अस्, इका, अम्, wearing knotted or matted
hair.

जटि, इस्, f. clotted or twisted hair, an assemblage,
multitude; the waved-leaf fig-tree, Ficus Venosa (=
प्लक्ष); [cf. जटी and धुर्जटि.]

जटी, f. the waved-leaf fig-tree [cf. जटि]; also =
जटा-मांसी.

जटिक, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing twisted or braided hair
(= जटिन् ?).

जटिन्, ई, इनी, इ, wearing the Jaṭā, having twisted
hair; (ई), m. an epithet of Śiva; N. of one of the
attendants of Skanda; an elephant sixty years old;
waved-leaf fig-tree (= प्लक्ष).

जटिल, अस्, आ, अम्, wearing the Jaṭā, having clotted
or entangled hair; complicated, twisted together,
intermixed, confused; (अस्), m. a lion; a goat with
certain marks; N. of a man; (आ), f., N. of a woman
with the patronymic Gautamī said to have had seven
husbands, mother-in-law of Rādhikā; N. of several
plants, = जटा-मांसी; long pepper; also = उच्चटा;
= वचा, Acorus Calamus; = दमनक.
—जटिल-
स्थल, अम्, n., N. of a place.

जटिलक, अस्, m., N. of a man; (आस्), m. pl. the
descendants of this man; (इका), f., N. of a woman.

जटिली-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्-
तुम्, to twist together, form into a clotted mass, to
braid; to complicate, interweave, wrap round.

जटिली-भाव, अस्, m. the being twisted together,
complication, confusion.

जटुल जटुल, अस्, m. a freckle, a mark;
[cf. जडुल.]

जाटलि जाटलि, इस्, ई, m. f. the plant Big-
nonia Suaveolens; (other readings have पाटलि and
झाटलि.)

जाटालिका जाटालिका, f. (fr. जटाल or जटा-
लक), N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda.

जाटिकायन जाटिकायन, अस्, m. (fr. जटिक),
N. of the author of a hymn of the Atharva-veda.
